premises.text: Content is the most important growth factor yet budgets are wasted on ineffective creative
premises.evidence_span: Content is the most important factor for growth. 47% of sales is attributed to the ad creative, and yet 25% of marketing budgets are wasted

premises.text: Turning design into data points reveals which creative features drive conversions
premises.evidence_span: by turning design into data points, we can discover what exactly about the creative is driving results

premises.text: Insights feed generative models that produce image prompts, copy, and headlines in seconds
premises.evidence_span: what used to take a team of marketers, designers, data scientists, copywriters, weeks, not months sometimes, of work has taken our AI mere seconds to generate

premises.text: Human annotation and explicit approval keep every ad on brand before multi-network launch
premises.evidence_span: Customers can annotate each ad, provide feedback, and ensure that every single content we're generating is on brand

premises.text: Ad-network API integrations ground generation in live performance data
premises.evidence_span: proprietary API integrations with all the ad networks and marketing platforms

value.text: Personalized ads that deliver conversions from real-time data while marketers stay in control
value.evidence_span: OmniKey lets customers harness the power of state-of-art machine learning and generative AI while staying in control

notes: Named foundation models (DALL-E, GPT-3, Stability) folded into generative capability. ICP 12M businesses treated as market framing.
